description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; add "trial": true to try up to 3 calls per IP per day free on tools up to $0.005; otherwise the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). [Web and domain checks] Pre-click / pre-pay risk signals for one URL: TLS validity and expiry, redirect chain (HTTPS downgrades, cross-domain hops), domain age via RDAP, brand lookalike and punycode/mixed-script signals, parked or scam-pattern content, seed-phrase or lookalike login forms, security-header grade, and, if the URL answers 402, whether its x402 challenge is valid (USDC on Base, payTo, amount, resource host). Output trust/2: signals[] with evidence, risk {level: low_observed_risk / elevated / high / unknown, score 0-100 = risk, confidence, observed bad rate}, coverage (what was not checked) and not_a_guarantee. No third-party blocklist; low observed risk is not a safety certification. Method and measured error rates: https://shop.lordevo.com/docs/trust-methodology
